methodology.consensus: Arithmetic mean of three independently rebuilt direction and reversal-risk assessments over the same fixed universe.
methodology.disparity_formula: 100 times the average of (direction-score range / 200) and (reversal-risk range / 100). Lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: Existing timing, key-metric, priced-in, low-bar reversal and disagreement controls applied; no new method change.
